landing.meta_tagline: Car, smartphone and device installments in one place
landing.meta_description: Apply for installments on new or used cars, smartphones and electronic devices, with plans of up to 60 months, and track your request online. Submitting an application is not a final financing approval.
landing.disclaimer_short: Submitting an application is not a final financing approval; all applications are reviewed and verified.
landing.disclaimer_full: Submitting an application is not a final financing approval. All applications are reviewed, the data is verified, and the financing party's conditions must be met.
landing.car_title: Your new or used car… closer than you think
landing.car_desc: Choose the right car and apply in clear steps, with financing options of up to 60 months (5 years), and cars available through authorised dealers with after-sales services.
landing.phone_title: Your new phone… closer to you
landing.phone_desc: Choose the right phone and apply for installments in easy online steps, with clear tracking of your request until it is complete.
landing.how_title: Three steps to start your journey with Ovfle
landing.step_1_desc: Pick the installment type: smartphone, electronic device, or car.
landing.step_2_desc: Complete your basic and financial details in clear, quick steps.
landing.step_3_desc: Follow your request status easily and get updates as they happen.
landing.req_title: Prepare your details before you start
landing.req_car: For cars: type, model and value
landing.cta_subtitle: Apply for car, smartphone or device installments now, or track a request you already submitted.

landing.s3_subtitle: Pay for smartphones and electronic devices in easy, flexible installments.
landing.s4_subtitle: Apply for new or used cars, smartphones or electronic devices, and benefit from installment plans of up to 60 months.
landing.about_title: Installments you can trust.. in a clear digital experience
landing.about_p1: Ovfle is a brand owned by Wafi World, offering installments on new and used cars, smartphones and electronic devices through an easy, clear digital experience.
landing.about_p2: Ovfle offers installment plans of up to 60 months (5 years), giving customers more flexibility to choose the repayment plan that suits them, subject to eligibility and the financing party's terms.
landing.about_p3: Ovfle builds on Wafi World's experience in devices and digital solutions to provide an organised experience, from submitting the request to tracking its status.
landing.about_p4: For cars, vehicles are supplied through authorised dealers with after-sales services, strengthening the quality and reliability of the experience.
landing.about_stat_months_label: Installment plans of up to 5 years
landing.services_subtitle: Ovfle makes it easy to submit and track your installment request online, with repayment plans of up to 5 years.
landing.device_title: The device you need… at an installment that suits you
landing.device_desc: Apply for electronic device installments easily and benefit from flexible repayment options to get the right device without hassle.
landing.why_title: Why is Ovfle your first choice?
landing.why_1: A trusted brand owned by Wafi World
landing.why_2: Installments for smartphones, electronic devices and cars
landing.why_3: A digital experience to apply and track
landing.partners_title: Partners who help you reach your choice
landing.partners_subtitle: We work with financing partners to provide car installment solutions with flexible repayment plans of up to 60 months.
landing.footer_about: Ovfle is a brand owned by Wafi World, offering installments on new and used cars, smartphones and electronic devices, with flexible repayment options and an easy digital experience to apply and track.
landing.footer_contact_text: For enquiries or help, contact us on Wafi World's unified number or through our customer service channels.
